_comment_place_order: Normal LIVE runs. true: BUY the traded option on entry and SELL it on exit (SL, 14:50 force exit, end of day, executor stop) through the broker utility. false: paper-trade only, no orders. Never applies to BACKTEST.
_comment_place_order_in_test_mode: LIVE test mode runs (--test_mode true --date ...) only, independent of place_order. true: send real orders for the replay's entries/exits.
_comment_order_type: Order type for both the BUY (entry) and SELL (exit) orders: "MARKET" or "LIMIT".
_comment_limit_buffer_percent: LIMIT only: BUY price = reference price + buffer%, SELL price = reference price - buffer%, rounded to tick_size. The reference price is the option's LTP at the signal.
_comment_order_route: How orders are sent. "api": Fyers API via the broker utility (needs the whitelisted static IP). "webhook": POST to the FYERS Automate webhook URL in Config/webhook_url.txt (gitignored -- anyone with that URL can trigger orders).
_comment_webhook_payload: webhook only: the JSON body sent per order. MUST match the message your FYERS Automate strategy expects -- this one is a placeholder. Placeholders: {symbol}, {fyers_symbol}, {transaction_type}, {side}, {quantity}, {order_type}, {product}, {price}, {reference_price}, {option_type}, {reason}.
